refs.title: Bowen Court - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'The court includes 23 bungalows arranged in an "L" shape and is one of the largest bungalow courts in southern California.'

refs.title: National Register of Historic Places Inventory Nomination Form
refs.note: The Pasadena bungalow-courts multiple-property nomination. Its own words: 'Bowen Court is the most well known extant bungalow court in Pasadena, and perhaps in the larger Los Angeles region as well'; 'it was one of the first courts to be built, and it is one of the two oldest to survive'; 'Bowen Court was constructed for $1,253 per unit while Gartz Court, built in the same year, cost $2,333 per unit.'

note: No HABS survey was found (query: '"Bowen Court" 539 East Villa Street Pasadena HABS CA- loc.gov pictures item' returned other Pasadena surveys). The name and location are spelled exactly as california-bungalow's exemplar already spells them, so that node could join this record without renaming -- and WP-11.3, Tranche 2 (5 Sep 2026): it has.
